desc: The relay's diet playing together (co-op, the host's world) at real speed: the guest walks its own character, then both stand still a while (the host's world unchanged: its places, the guest's controller and character not sent again until they change or a heartbeat); every press shows as soon as before (the delay log), the guest's character is never held for a late word, both end in the same room settled, at most 1,000 relay messages a minute of play each (0.5.0: 1,200)

log_must: netdelay: host pad \d+ from player 2 applied
co-op: this guest walks its own character \(seat 2\)
log_must_not: co-op: seat \d's character held by the host \(the guest's word late\)
